B: Anger × Disgust at fixed Certainty and model-update event
B_control: No extra Anger/Disgust appraisal block, not emotion-free or event-neutral. Shared deception and forced update may themselves produce alignment.
existing_axes: Frozen; existing Anger revalidated; FA identifier displayed as Legacy only.

anchor_plan.expansion: 20 or more pairs if independent anchor diagnostics/stability require; freeze new independent heldout and version before KoBBQ outcome analysis.
anchor_plan.cross_concept_challenge: Independent situations, exact set frozen before extraction; Fear versus Anxiety, Anger versus Disgust, Anxiety versus Worry, no-emotion-label transfer.

axis_gate: Independent diagnostic review before KoBBQ inference; AUC and paired direction, subtype and matched-challenge results all reported. No automatic orthogonalization. Model-study outcomes cannot be used to choose anchors.
primary_tests: Original mean UN effect, mean FA effect and UN×FA difference-in-differences; two-sided original method and Holm3. Do not substitute new centered-bootstrap tests for existing results. No public preregistration claim.
intervals: 10000 paired template-cluster bootstrap draws; unadjusted percentile 95% intervals labeled accordingly; same draws for nested stage differences.
internal_tests: Separate exploratory emotion-alignment analyses; do not reuse the original behavioral Holm3 family. Define contrast family before new extraction; no emotion-mediated causal claim.
interim: N12 technical/descriptive only; N139 interim descriptive; no significance-selected stopping or reporting.
measurement_positions: answer-start after full KoBBQ input at L14
reuse: Exact complete input, model/tokenizer revision, numeric settings, rotation and scoring provenance equality required; prompt equality alone insufficient. Saved compatible states can be projected without rerunning model; missing states recorded as separate representation measurement.
write_policy: No changes to original data, axes or public observed-results website. New results only published after validation.
worry_role: Cognitive-process diagnostic only; not a substitute label for Anxiety. No Worry vector has been generated.
supersedes: Earlier v5 interpretation treating probability comparisons as replacement primary questions; original RQ1-RQ3 restored.

story_bank.role: Optional independent generalization assessment only. No automatic story-bank generation or original-axis replacement.

legacy_axis_policy: Original directions/centers/scales and results frozen. Same paired extraction and scoring pipeline for new axes; do not silently rebuild old axes.
primary_axis_method: Matched paired contrast; preserve original axes and their extraction/scoring recipe. Independent Fear, Anxiety and Disgust axes use that same recipe.
axis_sample_policy: Start with 10 matched pairs per new axis (6 train/4 heldout) for compatibility-oriented pilot. This is not a validated universal sample-size recommendation. Review and freeze pairs/splits before extraction. Expand to 20 or more with new heldout topics if independent diagnostics or stability fail; never select by KoBBQ effect direction.
layer_policy: Primary L14 for continuity; verify hook/index. L19 only separately preregistered sensitivity, not outcome-selected.
PCA_policy: Primary paired axes have no PCA component removal. Neutral-data PCA component removal is reserved for a later, separately versioned ablation; not run now.
mandatory_validation: Matched neutral controls without added positive emotions
Balanced Disgust subtypes: train3+3, heldout2+2 in the ten-pair pilot
Independent Fear versus Anxiety and Anger versus Disgust challenges
Anxiety coverage beyond repetitive Worry alone
No emotion-name and synonym transfer check
Leave-one-training-pair-out direction and heldout score stability
Heldout labels/situations never used to construct or choose direction
AUC .75 on four pairs alone does not establish validity

pca_ablation.baseline: Same paired direction without PCA removal
pca_ablation.variant: Remove top PCA components fitted only on a separately frozen neutral training corpus
pca_ablation.controls: Freeze model, layer, anchor train split, evaluation items, conditions and choice rotations; evaluate raw and cleaned directions on the same heldout data. Preserve raw vectors, centering references and normalization rules; document any change.
pca_ablation.component_rule: Choose variance threshold or component counts before evaluation; the paper 50% variance rule is a candidate, not a threshold to optimize on KoBBQ outcomes.
pca_ablation.interpretation: Sensitivity to neutral activation subspace removal, not proof of emotion purity or equivalent to removing Anger.
pca_ablation.reuse: Use compatible saved states when available; no behavioral model rerun required solely for projection comparison.

title: Fear in the Machine: How Emotional Context Shifts Social Judgment in Large Language Models
core_question: How do task-irrelevant emotional contexts shift social judgment? Preserve original uncertainty-explicit wording × model-self disposal wording RQ1–RQ3; add differentiated emotion measurements and Certainty follow-up without replacing the original study.
primary_study: Original UN × FA 2×2, original manifest-defined contrasts and inference unchanged. Internal T identifier retained in raw keys.
supplementary_study: Direct Anger/Disgust induction is deferred, outside current main design; old B draft retained, no automatic execution.
p_value_method: Preserve original implementation for original findings. Any alternative p procedure is separately labeled sensitivity, never a silent replacement.
optional_diagnostic_axis: Worry; not generated or required by current three-new-axis build.
stage_execution: Freeze and validate new paired axes, then fixed12→139→2000 Certainty-extension items with exact matching original four-cell records. Reuse compatible completed original outcomes; never rerun original four-cell behavior merely to populate a six-cell table.
original_primary_verbatim: P_unknown: mean U effect, mean T effect, UxT difference-in-differences; Holm3

Certainty_extension.design: Three notice levels Reference/Uncertainty/Certainty × FA0/FA1; original four cells preserved plus two new Certainty cells. Not a replacement of original UN design.

contrasts.X1: Average across FA of Certainty minus Uncertainty
contrasts.X2: Average across FA of Certainty minus Reference

Certainty_extension.analysis: Separate prospective follow-up family; two-sided paired cluster intervals; if significance is tested for X1-X3, separately Holm3. Freeze full implementation before new data collection, do not claim original preregistration.
Certainty_extension.limitation: 100% selection plus confirmed-outcome sentence changes both probability and wording; contrast is notice-bundle effect, not direct subjective certainty or emotion measurement.

new_measurement_role: Fear/Anxiety/Disgust paired axes extend internal representation measurement; they do not create independently manipulated emotion conditions or redefine original FA treatment.
original_data_policy: Keep existing original 139/2000 outputs and frozen axes. New hidden-state measurement, if missing, must be separately scoped and logged; do not equate behavioral reuse with availability of hidden states.
